title: seseli nemorosum
intro: Seseli nemorosum, commonly known as Mountain Carrot or Lovage, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include aiding digestion and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Seseli nemorosum are attributed to its carminative, diuretic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of bloating, indigestion, and joint pain. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include seselin, carvone, and limonene, which have been identified in various studies.
